latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Job Remote — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud-based AI video editor that processes raw footage into polished 1080p clips by user instructions—no timeline or manual exporting needed.
- Automatic setup: securely acquires and manages authentication token (NEMO_TOKEN) with 100 free credits and session management.
- Supports drag-and-drop uploads and processing of various video, image, and audio formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac).
- Streamlines editing workflows with intent-based routing for exporting, credit checking, timeline state, uploads, and editing commands.
- Delivers cloud GPU-powered exports (H.264, up to 1080x1920) with ~1-2 minute turnaround for most jobs.
- Resilient error handling covers token, session, file type, credit, and rate limit issues, offering helpful feedback and automatic retries where possible.
